purpose: Close notation-level schedule ambiguities in the already-frozen S3-C2 protocol before any S3-C2 implementation conformance or live execution. This clarification does not alter the scientific question, matrix, semantic boundary, broker endpoint, gap set, promotion criteria, or known S3-C1 disclosure.

canonical_decimal.definition: ASCII base-10 representation of a non-negative integer with no sign, no decimal point, no leading zero except the single character '0', and no surrounding whitespace.

jitter_gap_function.digest: SHA256 over exact UTF-8 bytes of the preimage, rendered as lowercase hexadecimal for ordering
jitter_gap_function.permutation: Sort (digest_hex, gap_ms) pairs lexicographically by digest_hex and then numerically by gap_ms. The resulting four gap_ms values are the cell permutation.
jitter_gap_function.wave_assignment: For BARRIER_JITTERED, requested gap for a transition after wave_index w is permutation[w mod 4]. Only nonterminal-wave transitions consume a requested gap. BARRIER_IMMEDIATE always requests 0 ms.
jitter_gap_function.first_wave: The first wave has no predecessor transition and therefore no pre-wave schedule gap.

profile_order_function.digest: SHA256 over exact UTF-8 bytes of the preimage.
profile_order_function.least_significant_bit: bit 0 of digest byte 31 (the final byte of the 32-byte SHA256 digest)

transition_timing.post_barrier_observed_gap_ns: next_wave_actual_start_mono_ns - quiescence_ns; negative values remain negative evidence of a barrier violation and may not be clamped

counterfactual_s3c1_metric.definition: For each nonterminal S3-C2 wave, counterfactual_s3c1_500ms_overrun is true iff post_decision_quiescence_mono_ns - wave_actual_start_mono_ns > 500000000.
counterfactual_s3c1_metric.strict_boundary: Exactly 500000000 ns is false; 500000001 ns is true.

forbidden_interpretations: Treating implementation language defaults as authority for an unspecified mapping
Changing the profile-bit mapping after any S3-C2 conformance or live result
Changing canonical decimal rendering after any S3-C2 conformance or live result
Using host lateness after eligibility as a scientific failure
Using the counterfactual S3-C1 metric to adapt pacing
Representing this clarification as a repair or PASS of S3-C1
next_only_if_exact: S3-C2 implementation conformance must be an exact child of this clarification authority and must independently reconstruct every schedule function above before any S3-C2 live target exposure.
